result.topic_en: The page contains only drawings of curves with no text: nested closed curves and figure-eight (lemniscate-like) loops with marked points (crosses) and double points, a figure-eight crossed by a line beside a large oval, and ovals with zigzag (oscillating) segments along parts of their boundary, apparently illustrating level curves of a polynomial and the location of roots in the context of algebraic equations.

[Drawings only, no text: nested closed curves with two figure-eight loops, each lobe marked with a cross (×); a curve passing through a double point and continuing to a loop marked ×; a figure-eight marked × crossed by a horizontal line next to a large oval with zigzag marks along its upper and right boundary; a lower oval with a zigzag line along its lower edge.]
